tonight.title: Avengers: Doomsday
tonight.why: Tonight, dive into the unsettling psyche of a notorious tech mogul with 'You Can See Everything.' This docu-thriller offers an unnervingly intimate portrait of a convicted founder's final days of freedom, blurring the lines between confession and continued manipulation.

releases.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
releases.take: Before Katniss, there was another Quarter Quell, proving Panem's favorite pastime has always been brutal reality TV.

releases.title: The Odyssey
releases.take: Odysseus's commute home makes your worst traffic jam look like a leisurely stroll through Elysium.

releases.title: Hexed
releases.take: Suburban angst meets magical mayhem, proving that some teenage rebellions come with a side of spellcasting.

critic.title: You Can See Everything
critic.blurb: For an epic journey that truly tests the human spirit, 'The Odyssey' delivers a visually stunning and emotionally resonant adaptation of the classic tale. It's a grand adventure that reminds us why some stories endure for millennia.
